mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM ai_signal s WHERE s.agent_id=#{agentId} AND s.status NOT IN ('SUPPRESSED','INVALID') AND s.source_type <> 'RUNTIME_OBSERVATION' AND s.signal_type NOT IN ('TOOL_FAILURE','MCP_FAILURE','MODEL_FAILURE','MODEL_RATE_LIMIT','EXECUTION_FAILURE') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_evaluation_snapshot e WHERE e.agent_id=s.agent_id AND e.session_id=s.session_id AND e.assistant_message_id=s.assistant_message_id AND e.decision='NOT_ELIGIBLE' ) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_signal s WHERE s.agent_id=#{agentId} AND s.status='OPEN' AND s.source_type <> 'RUNTIME_OBSERVATION' AND s.signal_type NOT IN ('TOOL_FAILURE','MCP_FAILURE','MODEL_FAILURE','MODEL_RATE_LIMIT','EXECUTION_FAILURE') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM case_evaluation_snapshot e WHERE e.agent_id=s.agent_id AND e.session_id=s.session_id AND e.assistant_message_id=s.assistant_message_id AND e.decision='NOT_ELIGIBLE' )
